title: Water, water everywhere
content: I found this reddit from tiktok and have many many shared experiences with you all. I wanted to share some of my memorable WATER ones. Some I haven’t been to in years. Some I’m now able to leave: A public swimming pool in a mall that was a vertical cylinder. Literally a glass vertical tube. I got in at the top, but there were hundreds of feet below me. I swam down a few levels and could see people in the mall looking at me. The water felt very dense. I quickly got to the top. Went there in about 2015 and can remember it so vividly. Very bad vibes and I was able to “nope” myself out of there. Haven’t been there since, but the access to this pool was very similar to the “changing rooms” described here. There was so much space to change, but also, I felt there was “no space?” The floor was wet, the toilets were dirty* and the lockers weren’t working. The air was oppressive. No-one else was at all bothered by this and acted like it was normal. Watching a river from a bridge with loads of arches. An unfathomably wide river – in the middle of a city. It’s got weeds all going with the very fast current and hundreds of hammerhead sharks. I feel like I either escaped the river or I’m about to jump in. I’ve been here several times – the last time was about 2 years ago. My feeling here is fascination. Walking in the country on a hike and see puddles that have fish in them. They are too big for the puddles. There’s no ponds or rivers in sight that they may have come from. I’m really stressed about how to rescue them. I’ve been here several times, but it stopped about 5 years ago. Bought a house and discovered a whole lower layer I didn’t know about. Was elated, then I realised it was all water/pools / baths etc. The first layer was a foot bath like you used to get in swimming pools before you went to the main pool. Then there was a random deep bath, then another shallow foot bath, then a normal bath, then like a roman bath area – on and on it goes. The air is thick to breathe, cheap neon lighting and a “pale green” feeling. I’d bought this house, and I couldn’t believe I had all this space, but there were random people in there, it wasn’t clean, and I was mega stressed. I’ve been here three times. *Dirty toilets we all talk about. I’ve been 10+ times. I’m not a hyperclean person – I’m very “normal” and these toilets are gag-worthy. Full to the brim, spilling on the floor. No-one else is bothered at all. I’m disgusted and am always on the way to somewhere, but I need to use the toilet first. That’s another post about me needing to be somewhere, but can’t get there or if I do my hair / makeup/ dress is fucked. Thanks for reading! I’m so grateful I found this reddit.
